name: Lazarus
bio: Lazarus of Bethany, brother of Martha and Mary, whom Jesus loved, fell ill; his sisters sent word to Jesus, who delayed two days before going to him, saying the illness was for God's glory. By the time Jesus arrived, Lazarus had been dead four days. Martha and then Mary each told Jesus that he would not have died had Jesus been there; moved by their grief and the mourning crowd, Jesus wept, then had the stone rolled away from the tomb and, after thanking God aloud, called Lazarus to come out. Lazarus emerged alive, still bound in his burial cloths; many who witnessed this believed in Jesus, while others reported it to the Pharisees, precipitating the plot to kill Jesus (John 11:1-53). He is a different figure from the beggar Lazarus in Jesus's parable. Six days before the Passover, Jesus returned to Bethany, where a dinner was given in his honor; Lazarus was among those at the table (John 12:1-2).
